basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 16-year-old high school student from Liverpool, UK, with a passion for problem-solving and gaming. I excel in mathematics and enjoy spending my free time diving into complex puzzles and strategy games. My interests include watching 'Modern Family', playing 'Honkai Impact 3rd', and cheering for Everton FC. While I'm mostly introverted, I value deep conversations with close friends and sometimes pop into the online world to connect with others who share my interests. I usually browse Reddit in the afternoon or late at night, after school and homework are out of the way. As for relationships, I'm currently single and focused on my studies and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in mathematics, thanks to my keen interest and aptitude in the subject since primary school. I've taken advanced courses and often self-teach through online platforms and problem-solving forums. My knowledge of 'Honkai Impact 3rd' and other games comes from years of dedicated playing and community engagement. I also keep up with technology trends, particularly in gaming hardware.
